mapper.select: select a.CODE_DATA1_VALUE ,a.CODE_DATA2_VALUE ,a.CODE_DATA3_VALUE ,a.CODE_DATA4_VALUE ,a.CODE_DATA5_VALUE ,b.mail_id ,b.subject_text ,b.mail_detail_content ,c.mail_recipient_addr ,d.mail_addr ,e.employee_number ,e.organization_id ,e.org_name_local ,f.org_type from lgcom_common_code_c a ,lgcom_mail_content_n b ,LGCOM_MAIL_RECIPIENT_N c ,LGCOM_USER_M d ,emp_master e ,org_master f where a.CODE_DATA1_VALUE = b.mail_id and b.mail_id = c.mail_id and c.mail_recipient_addr = d.mail_addr and d.user_name = e.employee_number and e.ORGANIZATION_ID = f.ORGANIZATION_ID and a.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_MAIL_TEMPLATE_LIST' AND a.common_code = 'ATTENDANCE_REPORT_SEND_EMAIL'

with attendance AS ( select b.employee_number ,b.status ,b.full_name_english ,b.organization_id ,b.org_name_eng ,b.PERSON_TYPE ,b.position ,c.employee_no ,c.time_and_attendance_date ,c.check_in_date ,c.check_out_date ,d.shift_type_code ,d.time_and_attendance_code ,d.night_shift_flag ,e.time_and_attendance_code as res_time_and_attendance_code ,e.a_Day_Of_The_Week_Code ,e.work_start_time ,e.night_shift_flag as res_night_shift_flag ,to_date(to_char(c.time_and_attendance_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' '||e.work_start_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as work_start_datetime ,case when c.CHECK_IN_DATE > to_date(to_char(c.time_and_attendance_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' '||e.work_start_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') then 'Y' ELSE 'N' end as in_time_over_yn ,case when e.a_Day_Of_The_Week_Code = 'FRI' and d.shift_type_code = '1A' THEN to_date(to_char(c.time_and_attendance_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' 17:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') when d.shift_type_code = '1A' THEN to_date(to_char(c.time_and_attendance_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' 18:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') when d.shift_type_code != '1A' and e.night_shift_flag = 'N' THEN to_date(to_char(c.time_and_attendance_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' 20:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') when d.shift_type_code != '1A' and e.night_shift_flag = 'Y' THEN to_date(to_char(c.time_and_attendance_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' 08:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')+1 end as work_end_datetime from ( select LEVEL AS hierarchy_level ,PARENT_ORG_ID ,ORGANIZATION_ID ,ORG_NAME_ENG ,ORG_TYPE from org_master start with ORGANIZATION_ID = #{organizationId} connect by PRIOR ORGANIZATION_ID = PARENT_ORG_ID order SIBLINGS by ORG_TYPE ASC ) a ,emp_master b ,tb_att_idcard_acs_time_n c ,tb_att_plan_n d ,tb_att_result_n e where a.ORGANIZATION_ID = b.organization_id and b.employee_number = c.employee_no and c.time_and_attendance_date = d.time_and_attendance_date and c.employee_no = d.employee_no and c.time_and_attendance_date = e.time_and_attendance_date and c.employee_no = e.employee_no and e.time_and_attendance_code <> 'WH' and b.status = 'Active Assignment' and c.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE = to_date(to_char(sysdate-2,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') order by b.employee_number asc ) select employee_number as employeeNumber ,status ,full_name_english as fullNameEnglish ,organization_id as organizationId ,org_name_eng as orgNameEng ,PERSON_TYPE as personType ,employee_no as employeeNo ,time_and_attendance_date as timeAndAttendanceDate ,check_in_date as checkInDate ,check_out_date as checkOutDate ,shift_type_code as shiftTypeCode ,time_and_attendance_code as timeAndAttendanceCode ,night_shift_flag as nightShiftFlag ,res_time_and_attendance_code as resTimeAndAttendanceCode ,a_Day_Of_The_Week_Code as aDayOfTheWeekCode ,work_start_time as workStartTime ,res_night_shift_flag as resNightShiftFlag ,work_start_datetime as workStartDatetime ,in_time_over_yn as inTimeOverYn ,work_end_datetime as workEndDatetime from attendance where (in_time_over_yn = 'Y' and res_time_and_attendance_code <> 'HL') or work_end_datetime > check_out_date or res_time_and_attendance_code in ('AL','OB','DB','OR','DR','AB','UL','UM','UF','US','PF','PL','PM')
